name: NICKEL PRATT
note: PRATT ON PROSPERITY (doc 57 D2: 'The first time Thad comes to Prosperity in Act II, Pratt is on it, pulling up the stake: PRA_D2 plays as he arrives'; doc 04 PRA_D2: 'with a stake and a mallet, mid-jump, unhurried about it'). Beside the claim marker with his mallet and a new stake of his own. Once Thad has had it out with him (PRA_D2 option 1) he goes back next door at a walk, mallet in hand (errata 97 D). Errata 244 (doc 114 II-2, doc 115): he no longer goes home when Thad has it out with him. He stays on the claim until he is turned (T_PRATT_TURNED), and walks home then.
walkToNote: Between the claim marker and Pratt, facing him.
barksNote: Doc 07 writes no barks for Pratt.

sprite.frameNote: 0 the mallet resting on the ground · 1 breath (derived) · 2 the mallet on his shoulder · 3 the mallet raised overhead · 4 struck down on the new stake. Every `breakEvery` seconds he drives the stake, or shoulders the mallet (errata 77). · ACTED ONLY (doc 95, errata 148; cast-unify 73): 5 the mallet resting, his head bowed, looking at his boots. Played by its direction, never as a break.
sprite.statureNote: Tyler, 2026-11-06, after the leaner redraw: "scale wise, he still looks way bigger than Thad. I think his current frame needs to be scaled down to better match Thad." With his hat, his breadth and his mallet he read well over Thad at 1.03. Now 0.96 of the room's man, crown to sole: his hat brings him level with Thad. (Was 1.03: "The bigger man: room-25's master drew him 1.05 of Thad".)
sprite.figureHeightNote: ERRATA 234. Crown to sole, his hat excluded, the crown read from his eyes and chin (content/scale-anchors.json `figures`): 402. Was 386 (tools/art/figure-height.py --hat), which took a row at his eyebrows for the crown and drew him 1.01 of Thad, not the 0.96 Tyler ruled (statureNote).
sprite.redrawn: Errata 111 (Tyler, 2026-11-06): drawn from the locked cast master, cast-unify operation 19 (reference/cast-unify-17.txt), full figure, his mallet in every pose so it never appears or vanishes; cut with its own pixels and a clean edge on his feet; its own file.
sprite.buildNote: LEANER (Tyler, 2026-11-06: "standing next to Thad Pratt look like a much 'thicker' character"; he chose "Leaner, still sturdy"): redrawn in the same poses, an ordinary working man a little broader than Thad (cast-unify 49), cut by tools/art/cast-unify-cut.py; figureHeight is crown to sole, the hat not counted (tools/art/figure-height.py --hat).
sprite.levelManNote: ERRATA 234: the man his sheet was snapped to one level at (figureHeight 386 over stature 0.96), kept while his figureHeight is his true crown to sole. His art pixels are 0.96 of the level's (tests/one-level.test.mjs).

exit.note: Errata 244: turned (doc 57 D5), he goes back to his own claim, next door past the creek at the right (errata 97 C). Was: sent home by PRA_D2 option 1.
exit.walkNote: WALK-C: six frames posed on Thad's walk, the leaner Pratt (cast-unify 50; Tyler, 2026-11-06: "Pratt's gait is kind of awkward because his knee goes so high" -- briefed with low knees), cut by tools/art/walk-c.py; figureHeight crown to sole on the passing frame, as his standing frames are measured. strideRatio MEASURED FROM THESE FRAMES (R5f), calibrated on Thad's walk.
exit.speedNote: Tyler, 2026-11-06: "His gait is way better though but maybe still weirdly slow." Now 0.7 of his height a second (Thad walks 0.81), 266 px/s at his 0.96 stature. Was half his height a second, Deke's pace. Before that 80 px/s: "Pratt walks so slow it's hard to even figure out if his walk could be good."
